- The app is now available in 22 languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Romanian, Polish, Czech, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Arabic (right-to-left), Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese and Thai
- The app follows the phone's language, or the per-app language chosen in Android settings, and restarts to apply a change
- Fixed a few texts that stayed in French whatever the language (Yes/No, compass points, ship types and flags, signal quality, some section titles)
